section.heading: post by lieberma on Jul 21, 2007post by lieberma on Jul 21, 2007

section.paragraph: Figure why not start a thread to see where “we” go. Be kinda fun to see who goes where. After all, this is a tracking site.Figure why not start a thread to see where “we” go. Be kinda fun to see who goes where. After all, this is a tracking site.
I will start it and hopefully others will play along and have fun tracking at the same timeI will start it and hopefully others will play along and have fun tracking at the same time
Tomorrow KMBO to MDQ to KBKW to KDMW anticipated departure time 12ZTomorrow KMBO to MDQ to KBKW to KDMW anticipated departure time 12Z

First two legs, I will file GPS direct Third leg will be KBKW MRB V166 EMI KDMW with the hopes that P40 doesn’t expand.First two legs, I will file GPS direct Third leg will be KBKW MRB V166 EMI KDMW with the hopes that P40 doesn’t expand.
July 23rd KDMW to KBKW to KMDQ back to my home base KMBO Departure time 12ZJuly 23rd KDMW to KBKW to KMDQ back to my home base KMBO Departure time 12Z
First leg EMI V166 MRB KBKW 2nd and 3rd legs GPS directFirst leg EMI V166 MRB KBKW 2nd and 3rd legs GPS direct

section.paragraph: I’m currently flying VFR, so no tracking on FlightAware right now. I plan to start my intrument training in the not-so-distant future. So, when I do start, here’s the plane I rent.
